title: VLMgineer: Vision Language Models as Robotic Toolsmiths

contributions.purpose: 让机器人自动发明并使用物理工具
contributions.mechanism: VLMgineer 框架:VLM 零样本生成 URDF 工具+动作对,再经进化搜索(变异/交叉提示)迭代精炼
contributions.evaluation: 比人类语言指定的 VLM 设计平均归一化提升 64.7%,比现成人类工具提升 24.3%
contributions.domain: 机器人操作 / 工具设计
contributions.source_quote: We present VLMGINEER, a framework that harnesses the code generation abilities of vision language models (VLMs) together with evolutionary search to iteratively co-design physical tools and the action plans that operate them to perform a task.

contributions.purpose: 为自动工具发明提供评测基准
contributions.mechanism: RoboToolBench:PyBullet 中 12 个需创造性工具的日常操作任务,含逐任务密集奖励函数
contributions.evaluation: 12 任务覆盖 RLBench 改编、共设计文献与日常场景;方法/基线各跑 5 次报 best/平均奖励
contributions.source_quote: To facilitate future research and benchmarking, we also introduce ROBOTOOLBENCH, a comprehensive simulation suite comprising 12 diverse robotic tool-use manipulation tasks specifically designed to evaluate tool design and policy optimization methods.

contributions.purpose: 验证进化迭代模块的必要性
contributions.mechanism: 消融:完整框架 vs 仅初始采样(w.o. Evolution)对比 top 奖励
contributions.evaluation: 均值 top 奖励 Without Evo 约 0.66/best 0.78 → With Evo 约 0.96(图 6a)
contributions.source_quote: The results clearly demonstrate the efficacy of evolutionary refinement. VLMGINEER consistently achieves higher task rewards, showcasing its capability to explore and identify superior regions in the joint tool-action design space that remain inaccessible through initial sampling alone.

self_declared_provenance.quote: VLMGINEER builds upon existing Large Model-guided evolutionary methods to achieve effective tool-action co-design.

For several tasks (BringCube, CleanTable, GatherSpheres, ScoreGoal), we took inspiration from the subset of RLBench [70] tasks that involve tool use — note, however, that we expect that automated tool design will replace and improve the original tools from RLBench.

notes: 元数据适配问题:OpenReview 提交题为占位符"AI AI AI",PDF 实为人类作者(UPenn Gao 等)的 arXiv:2507.12644 论文,desk-reject 疑因不符合 AI 第一作者/披露要求;全文无 agents4science AI 参与 checklist,无任何 AI 自我披露。局限自述:仅仿真、动作为离散末端位姿、URDF 限于简单长方体几何、单任务优化。人类基线 case study 仅 3 人(LLM 专家/机器人专家/外行),样本量极小。BringCube/CleanTable 上与 RLBench 原工具 best 奖励打平,靠移动距离作 tie-breaker 判优。
